title: Responses client -> OpenAI chat upstream (openai-compatibility provider)
environment: Recording worker stack ports are dynamic (worker-1: reference + openai-compat mock per reports/oracle/BOOTSTRAP.md s3/s6 and probes/mocks/README.md; substitute per orchestrator routing, e.g. ref 8417->worker port, 22999->18999, 2300N->1900N). All port numbers and host.docker.internal:<port> references are masked dynamic fields. Config: openai-compatibility provider mock-openai, model mock-gpt-model alias mock-model, api-key mock-upstream-key; downstream auth key oracle-local-key-1 (not a secret).
mock_upstream_changes_required: mock_openai.py happy SSE stream MUST end with a 'data: [DONE]' frame (the current script omits it; without it every happy stream golden degrades into the S2d6-stream-nodone error case). Keep a variant (control key or X-Mock-Variant header, e.g. 'default-stream-nodone') that omits the terminator to record that case.

Add scripted reply variants, selectable per request via control file key 'variant' or an X-Mock-Variant request header (strip X-Mock-* headers before wire logging, as mocklib already does): default, default-stream-done, default-stream-nodone, tools-nonstream (+ -custom / -namespace reply names), reasoning-nonstream, length-nonstream, length-usage-stream, tools-stream, reasoning-stream, compact.
Add route POST /v1/responses/compact returning the canned compact reply (mirror of the codex mock's compact route).
All timestamps in scripted replies are fixed (created=1770000000, ids chatcmpl-mock-0001) so fixtures are byte-deterministic apart from transport headers and ports.

Round-1 follow-up variants: 'done-only-stream' (200 + text/event-stream, single 'data: [DONE]' frame, clean chunked close) and 'reasoning-only-stream' (role delta chunk, one reasoning_content delta chunk, then 'data: [DONE]'; no content, no finish_reason).
recording_order_notes: Run S2d6-error-nostream-429 and S2d6-error-stream-429 LAST: upstream 429 puts the single credential in a ~1s rate-limit cooldown that transient-error-cooldown-seconds:-1 does not disable.
Disconnect/nodone cases do not cool the credential down (transient cooldown disabled by -1) and can run anywhere.
Auth/model-notfound/compact-stream-rejected emit no upstream traffic; verify upstream.jsonl is empty for them.

cases.purpose: Full SSE sequence for a text stream, byte-exact: created(1) in_progress(2) output_item.added(3) content_part.added(4) output_text.delta(5) output_text.done(6) content_part.done(7) output_item.done(8) response.completed(9) + trailing lone \n. response.model=REQUESTED alias ('mock-model'). NO [DONE] downstream. SSE headers only committed with first frame. Requires mock happy stream WITH 'data: [DONE]' terminator.
